name: Eventify
description_en:
Eventify combines an event administration platform with attendee experiences such as agendas, networking, messages, polls and games. Its registration and onsite tools can connect the guest list to check-in and badge printing. The shared Eventify app and a separately branded app are different delivery choices.

Plan selection involves feature packages, attendee credits, ticket fees and optional services. The retrieved pricing text does not expose a reliable complete base-price matrix and contains conflicting ticket-fee wording, so this profile explains the units without inventing a starting subscription price.
description_zh:
Eventify 将活动后台与参与者体验结合，包括议程、交流、消息、投票和游戏。报名及现场工具把人员名单关联到签到与徽章打印，共享 Eventify 应用与独立品牌应用是不同交付选择。

选套餐需结合功能包、参与者额度、票费及服务。本次价格文字未完整展示可靠基础价格表，票费措辞也有冲突，因此本文说明单位，不虚构订阅起价。

core_features.explanation_en: Scan attendees at event or session entrances and support walk-ins.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在活动或场次入口扫描，并处理现场新增人员。

core_features.explanation_en: Higher packages include app access, meetings, notifications and gamification.
core_features.explanation_zh: 较高套餐包含应用、会面、通知和游戏化。

en: Connect conference registration, badges, session scans and attendee app content.
zh: 关联会议报名、徽章、场次扫描及参与者应用内容。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Select the package and import a test guest, then validate the intended printer and an offline-to-online scan.
steps.zh: 选择套餐、导入测试人员，核对打印机与离线后联网扫描。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Package features plus attendee credits, ticket charges and optional app/support services.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Base package amounts were not reliably visible. Register/Engage/Advance/Ultimate use attendee credits and feature differences, with ticket charges, overage and branded-app/service add-ons. The extracted ticket-fee figures conflict ($1 and $2); exact package/credit reset, taxes and checkout require confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 未可靠展示基础套餐金额。Register/Engage/Advance/Ultimate 按参与者额度及功能区分，另有票费、超额及品牌应用/服务附加项。抽取票费出现 $1 与 $2 冲突，需确认套餐、额度重置、税费及结账。

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Test the actual entrance and printer setup
sections.title_zh: 测试真实入口与打印配置
sections.en: Eventify describes QR scanning, iPad self-service kiosks, walk-in registration and automatic badge printing through Zebra, Brother or Epson hardware. Session scans record a different attendance level from entering the event. For an illustrative conference, check one pre-registered guest, one walk-in and one restricted session against the intended access rules. Vendor claims of three-to-five-second processing were not independently timed.
sections.zh: Eventify 介绍二维码扫描、iPad 自助终端、现场报名及通过 Zebra、Brother、Epson 打印徽章。场次扫描与活动入场是不同出席层级。例如会议可分别检查预报名者、现场新增者和受限场次的访问规则。本文未独立测量宣传的三至五秒处理。

sections.title_en: Validate reconnection, not only local success
sections.title_zh: 验证重新联网，而不只看本地成功
sections.en: The check-in page describes continued offline scans followed by synchronization when connectivity returns. It also supports several entrances sharing an attendee list. Ask how two disconnected devices resolve duplicate or conflicting check-ins, and test the dashboard after reconnection. A local success indication is not proof of synchronized attendance or valid certificate eligibility. No offline or certificate workflow was executed.
sections.zh: 签到页介绍断网继续扫描、联网后同步，并支持多个入口共享名单。需确认两台离线设备如何解决重复或冲突签到，并检查联网后的后台。本地成功不证明出席已同步或达到证书资格。本文未执行离线或证书流程。

sections.title_en: Separate app packages, credits and ticket charges
sections.title_zh: 区分应用功能包、额度与票费
sections.en: Register focuses on registration and onsite work; Engage adds attendee app and meetings, Advance adds richer branding/exhibitor tools, and Ultimate names AI functions. Some analytics remain labelled coming soon. Cards and comparison text show differing included-credit figures and $1 versus $2 ticket-fee labels without a stable extracted column mapping. Confirm the chosen package, credit period, ticket fee and add-on app price rather than publishing a precise combined total from this view.
sections.zh: Register 侧重报名与现场，Engage 增加参与者应用和会面，Advance 增加品牌及展商工具，Ultimate 列 AI 功能；部分分析仍标“即将推出”。卡片与表格额度不同，并出现 $1 与 $2 票费，抽取后列对应不稳定。应确认套餐、额度周期、票费及附加品牌应用价格，不能据此公布精确总额。

sections.title_en: Confirm the day-of-event support and data exit
sections.title_zh: 确认活动日支持与数据退出
sections.en: The site lists remote/on-site assistance, content-entry services and custom branded app options as additions. Confirm supported devices, printer stock, support coverage, payment provider and exports before deployment. Eventify merits investigation when app engagement and onsite operations must connect; a simple ticket link may require fewer tools. No self-hosted package or source-code license was verified, and reliability, security and attendance outcomes were not independently audited.
sections.zh: 官网把远程/现场帮助、内容录入和品牌应用列为附加选择。部署前需确认设备、打印耗材、支持、支付商和导出。当应用互动与现场运营需要关联时可以考虑 Eventify，简单售票链接可能只需更少工具。本次未确认自托管服务包或源码许可，也未独立审计可靠性、安全及出席效果。

research_gaps: No app, check-in, printer, offline merge, ticket payment, AI function or export was tested.
Base amounts, conflicting ticket fees/credits, roadmap availability, hardware/support costs, contract terms, license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
